status.title: System status
status.apiUnreachableBody: The API isn't responding, so the database and Redis can't be checked.

errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
errors.INVALID_JSON: The request couldn't be read. Please try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
errors.API_UNAVAILABLE: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.ALREADY_LEADS_GUILD: You already lead a guild. Transfer its leadership before creating another.
errors.DISCORD_SERVER_TAKEN: That Discord server is already connected to another guild.
errors.DISCORD_NOT_CONFIGURED: Discord isn't set up on this server yet, so guilds can't be connected.
errors.DISCORD_UNAVAILABLE: Discord isn't responding right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE: The file couldn't be read as an image.
errors.MEMBER_ALREADY_ON_ROSTER: This Discord user is already on the roster.
errors.GUILD_MASTER_CANNOT_BE_REMOVED: The Guild Master can't be removed from the roster. Transfer leadership first.
errors.REGISTRATION_NOT_PENDING: This registration was already approved or rejected.
errors.EVENT_STARTED: This event has started, so it can't be changed or cancelled.
errors.EVENT_CANCELLED: This event was cancelled, so it can't be changed.
errors.SERIES_STOPPED: This recurring series was stopped, so it can't be changed.
errors.SIGN_UP_NOT_TENTATIVE: Only Tentative participants can be replaced, and this one has confirmed or left the slot.
errors.NOT_ON_WAITLIST: That character is no longer on the waitlist for this role.

validation.RACE_NOT_IN_FACTION: This race isn't available for the chosen faction.
validation.CLASS_NOT_FOR_RACE: This class isn't available for the chosen race.
validation.DUPLICATE_PROFESSION: Each profession can only be listed once.
validation.TOO_MANY_PRIMARY_PROFESSIONS_one: A character can have at most {{count}} primary profession.
validation.TOO_MANY_PRIMARY_PROFESSIONS_other: A character can have at most {{count}} primary professions.
validation.CLASS_CANNOT_FILL_ROLE: This class can't fill that combat role.
validation.NAME_NOT_ALLOWED: This name contains a word that isn't allowed.
validation.DISCORD_SERVER_NOT_MANAGEABLE: The bot must be in this server, and you need the Manage Server permission in it.
validation.OFFICER_ROLE_NOT_FOUND: This role isn't in the server, or can't be used as the Officer role.
validation.CHARACTER_NAME_TAKEN: Another character already has this name.
validation.CHARACTER_WRONG_FACTION: The character's faction must match the guild's.
validation.DISCORD_USER_NOT_IN_SERVER: This Discord user isn't on the guild's Discord server.
validation.DUNGEON_SLOTS_FIXED: A dungeon always has the standard 5-player group, and its slots can't change.
validation.SLOTS_DONT_ADD_UP: The slots of the three combat roles must add up to the size.
validation.EVENT_STARTS_IN_PAST: Pick a date and time in the future.
validation.EVENTS_CHANNEL_NOT_USABLE: The bot can't see, write, or post embeds in this channel. Choose another one or fix its permissions in Discord.
validation.PRE_CONFIRMED_NOT_ALLOWED: Participants can only be pre-confirmed for a one-time raid.
validation.PRE_CONFIRMED_ROLE_FULL: More pre-confirmed participants than the role has slots.
validation.PRE_CONFIRMED_CANNOT_JOIN: This character isn't on the roster, or its member can't join raids.
validation.PRE_CONFIRMED_ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED: This character's class can't fill that role.
validation.PRE_CONFIRMED_TWICE: Each member can be pre-confirmed with only one character.

login.lead: Run your guild's roster, events and attendance. Raiders and Members can log in to see events and the roster.
login.note: You need to be on your guild's roster, or have the Officer role in its Discord server. Setting up a new guild? Log in and you'll be guided through it.

errors.cancelled: Login cancelled on Discord. Try again when you're ready.
errors.failed: The login with Discord didn't work. Please try again.
errors.not_configured: Login with Discord isn't set up on this server yet.

settings.title: User settings
settings.timeZoneHelp: Every date and time in the app is shown in this time zone.

setup.title: Set up your guild
setup.lead: Three steps. Everything except the faction can be changed later in Guild settings.
setup.name: Guild name
setup.factionHelp: Only characters of this faction can be on the roster. It can't be changed later.
setup.botHelp: The bot posts events and collects sign-ups. Add it to your guild's Discord server, then choose the server here.
setup.addBot: Add the bot to a Discord server
setup.serversHelp: Only servers where the bot is and you have the Manage Server permission are listed.
setup.noServers: No servers yet. Add the bot to a server where you have the Manage Server permission, then come back to this page.
setup.noRoles: This server has no roles that can grant Officer. Create one in Discord (Server Settings → Roles), then reload.
setup.officerHelp: Members with this role are Officers and can manage the guild in this app. You're the Guild Master of this guild. You can transfer leadership later in Guild settings.

dashboard.lead: Your guild is set up. Upcoming events, missing roles, and pending registrations will show up here.
dashboard.unavailable: Can't be read from Discord right now

noAccess.title: You don't have access to Guild Manager
noAccess.body: Your Discord account isn't the Guild Master of any guild, and doesn't have the Officer role in any guild's Discord server.
noAccess.signUp: Use the buttons on the event posts in your guild's Discord server. You don't need this app.
noAccess.officer: Ask your Guild Master to give you the Officer role in Discord, then log in again.
noAccess.newGuild: Set up your own guild. You'll be its Guild Master.
noAccess.otherAccount: Log in with a different account

guildPicker.title: Choose a guild
guildPicker.lead: You have access to more than one guild. You can switch later from the sidebar.

guildSettings.title: Guild settings
guildSettings.identityHelp: How the guild appears in the app.
guildSettings.name: Guild name
guildSettings.imageHelp: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 5 MB. It is cropped square.
guildSettings.imageTooLarge: The image is too big. Use one up to 5 MB.
guildSettings.imageWrongType: Use a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
guildSettings.discordHelp: The server the bot posts in, the role that makes members Officers, and where and in which language events are posted.
guildSettings.serverUnavailable: Can't be read from Discord right now
guildSettings.ownerNote: Owning the Discord server doesn't make someone the Guild Master here.
guildSettings.chooseRole: Choose the Officer role for the new server.
guildSettings.gmOnly: Only the Guild Master can change these.
guildSettings.saveFailed: Some changes could not be saved
guildSettings.leaveBody: Your changes to the guild settings will be lost.
guildSettings.eventsChannelHelp: Only channels where the bot can see, write, and post embeds are listed. Changing it moves the posts of upcoming events.
guildSettings.chooseChannel: Events aren't posted in Discord until you choose a channel.
guildSettings.noChannelMatch: No channel matches. The bot needs to see, write, and post embeds in it.
guildSettings.discordLanguageHelp: Event posts and missing-role alerts use this language.
guildSettings.signUpsHelp: The Guild Master and Officers can change these.
guildSettings.tentativeExample: Tentative sign-ups close {{deadline}} hours before each event (unless it has its own deadline), and the reminder goes out {{reminder}} hours before it starts. Upcoming events whose new deadline would already have passed keep the old one.

addMember.title: Add member
addMember.lead: Add someone who hasn't used /register. They need to be on the Discord server.
addMember.searchUser: Type at least 2 letters of their name
addMember.noUsers: No one on the server matches.
addMember.factionHint: Only races and classes of the {{faction}} are shown.
addMember.restored: {{name}} was on the roster before; their previous record is back.
addMember.unrestored: These characters stay removed because another character has their name now: {{names}}.
addMember.noCharacters: No characters yet. They can be added now, later on the member's page, or with /register.

character.name: Character name
character.professionsHint: Up to 2 primary professions; {{secondary}} have no limit.

member.rankFromDiscord: Comes from the Officer role in Discord. Change it there.
member.rankGuildMaster: The Guild Master changes by transferring leadership.
member.rankOfficerOnly: Only the Guild Master can change the rank of an Officer.
member.removeBody: Their attendance history is kept, and their characters can join another guild. Adding them back restores their record.
member.cannotRemoveGm: The Guild Master can't be removed. Transfer leadership first.
member.cannotRemoveOfficer: Only the Guild Master can remove an Officer.
member.notesPrivate: Only visible to the Guild Master and Officers.
member.notFound: This member isn't on the roster.
member.removeCharacterBody: Its past sign-ups and attendance are kept, and its name becomes free. Adding it back to this member restores it.
member.removeMainBody: It's the main, so the member's oldest other character becomes the main. Its past sign-ups and attendance are kept, and its name becomes free.
member.leftDiscordBody: They can't sign up for events while they're not on the server. They stay on the roster until an Officer removes them, and the flag clears if they come back.
member.baseRankHint: Used if they lose the Officer role in Discord.

registrations.title: Pending registrations
registrations.lead: Members registered from Discord with /register. Approve them to add them to the roster.
registrations.returning: Was on the roster: comes back with their characters
registrations.rejectBody: {{name}} gets a direct message saying an Officer rejected the registration.

eventForm.name: Name
eventForm.dungeonFixed: A dungeon is always 5 players in the standard group.
eventForm.readOnly: This event has started or was cancelled, so it can't be edited.
eventForm.repeat: Repeat every week on this day
eventForm.repeatHint: A new event is created every 7 days at the same time, two weeks ahead. The time is kept in UTC, so it moves by an hour when daylight saving time changes.
eventForm.seriesStopped: This series was stopped, so it can't be edited.
eventForm.slotsAddUp: Slots add up to the event size.
eventForm.hintDate: Pick a date and time to save.
eventForm.hintFuture: Pick a date and time in the future to save.
eventForm.hintSlots: Make the slots add up to the size to save.
eventForm.hintFix: Fix the fields marked in red to save.
eventForm.losingSlots_one: Saving moves 1 participant to the front of the waitlist, and they get a direct message:
eventForm.losingSlots_other: Saving moves {{count}} participants to the front of the waitlist, and they get a direct message:
eventForm.preConfirmedHelp: They start as Confirmed and take a slot, and get a direct message. Only the Guild Master sees this.
eventForm.preConfirmedNoMember: No member matches. Only Raiders, Officers, and the Guild Master can join raids.

eventPage.cancelBody: It stays listed as cancelled, with who cancelled it and when. Sign-ups close and the Discord post is marked as cancelled. This can't be undone.
eventPage.started: This event has started, so it can't be edited or cancelled.
eventPage.cancelledText: Cancelled on {{date}} by {{name}}. Sign-ups are closed and the Discord post shows the event as cancelled.

post.note: Preview of the message the bot posts in {{channel}}, in {{language}}. It updates as people sign up.
post.noChannelHelp: The bot posts events once the Guild Master chooses an events channel in the guild settings.
post.failed: The bot couldn't post this event

errors.missing_permissions: The bot needs to see, write, and post embeds in {{channel}}. Fix its permissions in Discord and it tries again right away.
errors.channel_not_found: {{channel}} no longer exists. Choose another events channel in the guild settings.

eventPage.removeBody: Their sign-up is deleted and their spot goes to the first on the waitlist. They get a direct message saying you removed them, and can sign up again from Discord.
eventPage.replaceBody: Pick someone from the waitlist to take the spot. {{name}} moves to the end of the waitlist, and both get a direct message.
eventPage.tentativeCloses: Tentative closes {{date}} · {{hours}} h before the start

series.title: Recurring events
series.dstHint: Events repeat at the same UTC time, so their local time moves by an hour when daylight saving time changes. Editing the series changes all its future events, including ones edited on their own.
series.stopBody: Its future events are removed and no more are created. Its past events stay.
series.stoppedText: Stopped on {{date}} by {{name}}. No more events are created.
series.signUpsPerEvent: Members sign up for each event of the series in Discord.
